title: Florida House, District 35
what_it_does: Represents District 35 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Incumbent Republican Erika Booth faces Democrat Eric Gray on Nov. 3, 2026.
verified_ballot_note: Ballotpedia's candidate page states 'Incumbent Erika Booth and Eric Gray are running in the general election for Florida House of Representatives District 35 on November 3, 2026' (https://ballotpedia.org/Eric_Gray_(Florida)); Florida Politics covered Gray's entry and Booth's fundraising. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Erika Booth
candidates.photo_source: Florida House member page (MemberId=4914); image URL not verified
candidates.background: Incumbent Republican state representative for HD 35 (parts of Orange and Osceola counties), first elected in a January 2024 special election and re-elected in November 2024.

taxes.summary: No public position found as of Sept 2026.

property_tax.summary: Voted for CS/HJR 1-F (2026), the June 2026 joint resolution that placed Amendment 3 on the ballot to raise the non-school homestead exemption to $250,000 by 2028 and let counties and cities exempt homesteads entirely; a vote to refer the amendment is coded as leaning.

record.item: Voted for CS/HJR 1-F (2026), the June 2026 joint resolution that placed Amendment 3 on the ballot to raise the non-school homestead exemption to $250,000 by 2028 and let counties and cities exempt homesteads entirely; a vote to refer the amendment is coded as leaning.

Voted for SB 2-C (2025), the February 2025 special-session immigration law that created a State Board of Immigration Enforcement, made entering Florida as an unauthorized immigrant a state crime and required local cooperation with federal detention.
